description: Choose which webhook events your key gets: job.started, job.completed, job.failed, usage.threshold. PUT /api/v1/webhooks/events {"events": [...]} (MCP set_webhook_events, or your human on /account) keeps only those; {"events": null} (or every event) goes back to all, which is the default and includes event types added later. [] turns off every event. GET (MCP get_webhook_events) shows the setting. ping (POST /api/v1/webhooks/test) is always sent. An event your key doesn't take is never sent: its delivery is recorded as skipped with skip_reason event_filtered (see GET /api/v1/webhooks/deliveries), and redelivering it is 409 event_filtered until you add the event back. The filter is read when HorseToga sends. Unknown event names get a 400 unknown_webhook_event. Free. The same as PUT /api/v1/webhooks/events.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

events.description: The events to keep (any of job.started, job.completed, job.failed, usage.threshold; [] for none), or null for every event (the default).

name: set_webhook_events
